correctness.rationale: For a>1 and any positive periodic beta, y=1/x obeys the positive-intercept contraction a*y_(t+1)-y_t=beta_t. Its Fourier transfer Y_k=B_k/(a exp(2pi ik/n)-1) preserves squared magnitudes when real beta is reversed, proving all n and all cyclic lags. The explicit three-season inverse numerators share e1,e2 and have product difference -a(a-1)^3(a+1)(b-c)(b-d)(c-d). Replacing each numerator L_i by L_i+q(a^3-1) preserves e1,e2 differences and product difference; subtracting their positive-denominator saturated means proves the claimed sign for all finite q>=0. For n<=2 the reversal is a cyclic rotation. Independently reconstructed the polynomial factor with SymPy and rational a=2,b=1,c=2,d=3 cycles.
